entries.summary: Build one readable entrance-display-exit chain, fit it to the tier duration, preserve anchors, and complete the exit or exact endpoint settle.
entries.use_when: The motion chain, timing, entry, exit, tempo, or main beat needs to be inferred or checked.
entries.avoid_when: The complete compliant one-shot motion chain is already specified.

entries.summary: Choose exactly one primary trajectory, state-change, or subject-action family and specify its physical mechanics.
entries.use_when: The user supplies a subject or theme but not a complete motion mechanism.
entries.avoid_when: A compliant primary motion family is explicitly fixed.

entries.summary: Apply asymmetric phase budgets, final-ten-frame protection, acceleration, deceleration, overshoot, rebound, and complete settling.
entries.use_when: The 300-999 motion needs stronger four-second direction, or a 99-299 action needs a compressed directed rhythm.
entries.avoid_when: The task already specifies a complete compliant phase rhythm and nonlinear motion mechanism.

entries.summary: Stage supplied components causally, choose a function-specific climax, and cool one sourced effect family in the final ten frames.
entries.use_when: The gift contains multiple components, lacks a subject-specific main beat, or needs a readable effect peak and cooling behavior.
entries.avoid_when: A single-component task already defines its causal climax, recovery, and effect decay precisely.

entries.summary: Use quantified central-safe sizing and reserve breathing room for delayed appendages and attached effects.
entries.use_when: Depth approach, large motion, ribbons, wings, trails, hanging parts, or an expanding effect risks cropping the defining silhouette.
entries.avoid_when: The subject and every attached effect already have explicit safe framing and breathing room.

entries.summary: Limit the gift to one sourced effect system, apply source-action-result causality, price calibration, decay, and solid-field containment.
entries.use_when: Effects, trails, particles, glow, transformation, material response, or environmental response appear or must be inferred.
entries.avoid_when: The task explicitly requires a purely physical effect-free motion.

entries.summary: Keep one continuous viewpoint, choose one camera job, preserve safe framing and background stability, and complete the exit.
entries.use_when: Camera behavior, subject tracking, framing, background behavior, or exit composition needs to be inferred or checked.
entries.avoid_when: All one-shot camera and exit mechanics are already explicitly compliant.

entries.summary: Protect human identity, hands, contact order, anatomy, body distance, and stable interaction.
entries.use_when: A person, hand, couple, touch, handoff, instrument contact, or close interaction appears in text or images.
entries.avoid_when: No human or human-like contact appears.

sections: Antlers, horns, wings, tails, and ribbons
entries.summary: Preserve animal anatomy, gait, orientation, attachments, and delayed appendage motion.
entries.use_when: Animals, fantasy creatures, antlers, horns, wings, tails, or ribbons appear.
entries.avoid_when: No animal or appendage risk appears.

entries.summary: Preserve vehicle direction, wheel and carriage logic, mechanical support geometry, and instrument anatomy.
entries.use_when: Vehicles, trains, rides, tracks, wheels, machines, or musical instruments appear.
entries.avoid_when: No vehicle, machine, ride, or instrument appears.

entries.summary: Control structural growth, dimensional conversion, particles, fireworks, water, ripples, and reflections inside one action chain.
entries.use_when: Assembly, growth, flattening, particles, petals, snow, dust, fireworks, water, splashes, or reflections appear.
entries.avoid_when: No transformation or material-system risk appears.

entries.summary: Keep the required uniform background unchanged and complete a physically readable exit without remnants.
entries.use_when: Price is below 500, an exact background marker is active, or the subject/effect must leave, retract, close, compact, or fade out.
entries.avoid_when: Price is 500-999 without an exact background marker, and an exact final-frame endpoint replaces the ordinary exit.
